report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency issues, but current gateway telemetry is healthy: error_rate 0.0012, p95 70ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters, all spans OK, logs status 200. This contradicts the alert and supports no bounded root-cause candidate. Downstream services (order, inventory, payment, postgresql, redis) have no current observations. Handing off for evidence from the affected service and alert window.
missing_evidence: Current error-rate/latency telemetry for order, inventory, payment, postgresql, and redis services
Gateway error logs or failing spans during the alert window (current logs show only status 200 OK)
Evidence of db pool waiters, dependency timeouts, or redis timeouts at the affected service
Deployment or configuration change records correlated with the alert window
